vopros: What is Remote CFO & Accounting Solutions in Tampa, and what do they do?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Remote CFO & Accounting Solutions, LLC is a Tampa, Florida–based financial services business. Florida state records show that the company was formed in November 2021 and is currently active. Julia Dospehoff is listed as its manager and registered agent, with a principal address in Tampa. ([search.sunbiz.org](https://search.sunbiz.org/Inquiry/CorporationSearch/GetDocument?aggregateId=flal-l21000488130-2e624945-25aa-449f-880a-4bfffb23ecbb&formatType=PDF&transactionId=l21000488130-a17b9744-6e6b-4621-89f9-f0f2d6471403&utm_source=openai))

The name indicates that it operates as an outsourced or “fractional” finance/accounting provider—essentially giving businesses access to accounting and CFO-level expertise without hiring a full-time CFO or building a full internal accounting department. I couldn't find a substantial current company website that spells out its exact service menu, so I wouldn't assume every typical fractional-CFO service is offered.

Generally, a firm of this type would be brought in to handle or advise on areas such as:
- Bookkeeping and financial accounting
- Monthly financial statements and management reporting
- Cash-flow management and forecasting
- Budgeting and financial planning
- CFO-level analysis and advice to business owners
- Improving accounting processes and controls
- Helping management understand profitability, expenses, margins, and other financial KPIs

The “remote” part generally means those functions are performed virtually rather than requiring an accountant or CFO to work at the client's location.

There is some independent evidence connecting Julia Dospehoff specifically with the business: local-business directory pages identify her with Remote CFO & Accounting Solutions, and one business owner describes having worked with her for years and characterizes her as professional, detail-oriented, and knowledgeable. ([alignable.com](https://www.alignable.com/tampa-fl/cti?utm_source=openai))

If you're asking because you're considering working for them, hiring them, or were contacted by them, I can also dig into their online presence, ownership, reviews, services, and whether the company appears legitimate.
